_howto: Each tool appears in its group (established or predictive) on /calculators/. Established tools link to their own page. Models open a model card at /calculators/model?id=<id>. status: live | in-development | planned. A model is calculated in the browser when it has an 'engine' (see examples/logistic-model-example.json), or embedded when it has an 'embedUrl' (e.g. a shinyapps.io app). Leave a field empty to hide it. Models built from ACS NSQIP data need "dataSource": "nsqip" so the NSQIP disclaimer is shown.

groups.name: Predictive Models
groups.intro: Prediction models from single-center and multicenter data, including ACS NSQIP. Each has a model card describing its development cohort, validation, and limitations.

nsqipDisclaimer: The American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Program and the hospitals participating in the ACS NSQIP are the source of the data used herein; they have not verified and are not responsible for the statistical validity of the data analysis or the conclusions derived by the authors.

tools.name: Cranial Vault Asymmetry Index
tools.summary: Quantifies plagiocephaly from two cranial diagonals and grades it on the Children's Healthcare of Atlanta scale.

tools.name: Cephalic Index
tools.summary: Head width as a percentage of length, for brachycephaly and scaphocephaly.

tools.name: Argenta Classification
tools.summary: Clinical staging of positional plagiocephaly (types I to V) and brachycephaly (types I to III).

tools.name: Head Circumference Z-Score (WHO)
tools.summary: Head circumference z-score and percentile for age and sex, birth to 5 years.

tools.name: Corrected Age for Prematurity
tools.summary: Chronological, corrected, and postmenstrual age for infants born preterm.

tools.name: GILLS Score
tools.summary: Predicts tongue-lip adhesion success in Robin sequence from five preoperative factors.

tools.name: Facial Injury Severity Scale
tools.summary: Point score for craniomaxillofacial fractures and lacerations.

tools.name: Estimated Blood Volume and Allowable Blood Loss
tools.summary: Weight- and age-based blood volume with maximum allowable blood loss by the Gross formula, for cranial vault and other pediatric cases.

tools.name: Maintenance Fluids (Holliday-Segar)
tools.summary: Hourly and daily maintenance fluid requirements by weight.

tools.name: CranioSTRIP
tools.summary: Machine learning model estimating perioperative transfusion risk in craniosynostosis surgery.

tools.name: Cleft Palate Speech Outcomes
tools.summary: Machine learning model estimating speech outcomes after cleft palate repair.
